# `aitbc agent-comm status`

Get detailed status and metadata for a registered agent.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent-comm status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-id` | text | — | yes | The Agent id. |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent-comm status --agent-id <agent_id>
```
